entity.summary: Decentralized automated-market-maker exchange and liquidity marketplace for the Superchain. Velodrome launched on 2022-06-02 and remains an active token-swap and liquidity protocol.
entity.notes: First-party documentation states that Velodrome launched on 2022-06-02 and describes it as an AMM designed to enable token swaps and liquidity provision. The current first-party application remains live and identifies Velodrome as a decentralized exchange. Lisk documentation separately identifies a Lisk-network Velodrome deployment, but HEI does not treat the announced 2026-10-31 Lisk Chain shutdown as a whole-entity Velodrome shutdown; deployment-level disposition remains tracked under issue #888. As of 2026-10-15, the Aero consolidation is announced but not confirmed completed; legacy AERO/VELO emission end is scheduled for 2026-10-22 00:00 UTC. This is not an entity-level shutdown classification.

events.title: Velodrome Finance launched
events.description: Velodrome Finance launched as an automated-market-maker exchange and liquidity protocol on 2022-06-02.
events.notes: Exact launch date is stated in current first-party Velodrome documentation.

events.title: Aero unification and legacy AERO/VELO emissions cutoff announced
events.description: The forthcoming Aero transition involves Aerodrome and Velodrome. Extra Finance announced that legacy AERO and VELO incentive emissions are scheduled to end on 2026-10-22 at 00:00 UTC and that borrowing for new Extra Finance leveraged farming positions would pause on 2026-10-14 at 08:00 UTC. The announcement does not establish that Velodrome Finance has ceased exchange operations or completed migration.
events.notes: This is an announcement/transition milestone, not a completed merger, shutdown or token conversion. Recheck status after the announced October 22 cutoff.

evidence.title: About Velodrome
evidence.notes: First-party documentation describes Velodrome as an AMM for token swaps and states that it first launched on 2022-06-02.

evidence.title: Velodrome Finance exchange application
evidence.notes: Current first-party application identifies Velodrome as a decentralized exchange offering token swaps and liquidity deposits, supporting active status.

evidence.title: Aerodrome official documentation — planned consolidation with Velodrome into Aero
evidence.notes: First-party Aerodrome documentation explicitly describes the planned 2026 merger with Velodrome into Aero. It does not establish an effective merger date.

evidence.title: Extra Finance — Aero Upgrade: Important Notice for Extra Finance Users
evidence.notes: Extra Finance's official announcement specifies planned 2026-10-22 00:00 UTC legacy AERO/VELO emission end and 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC borrowing pause; full Medium article was not independently accessible, so this exact timetable is cross-checked against the official account announcement.
